name: Wacom Bamboo
author: mug31
description: Wacom tablet settings from the bar: target display, flipped/left-handed orientation, active area, pressure, finger touch, and pen/ExpressKey remapping. Adapts to Bamboo, Intuos and One by Wacom models via libwacom.

barWidget.description: Tweak a Wacom pen tablet, its touch and its buttons from the bar.
